title: 2016 HMMT February Guts Problem 20
statement: Let \(A B C\) be a triangle with \(A B=13, A C=14\), and \(B C=15\). Let \(G\) be the point on \(A C\) such that the reflection of \(B G\) over the angle bisector of \(\angle B\) passes through the midpoint of \(A C\). Let \(Y\) be the midpoint of \(G C\) and \(X\) be a point on segment \(A G\) such that \(\frac{A X}{X G}=3\). Construct \(F\) and \(H\) on \(A B\) and \(B C\), respectively, such that \(F X\|B G\| H Y\). If \(A H\) and \(C F\) concur at \(Z\) and \(W\) is on \(A C\) such that \(W Z \| B G\), find \(W Z\).

solutions.text:
Answer:

\[\begin{array}{|c|}
\hline 1170 \sqrt{37} \\
1379 \\
\hline
\end{array}\]

Observe that \(B G\) is the \(B\)-symmedian, and thus \(\frac{A G}{G C}=\frac{c^{2}}{a^{2}}\). Stewart's theorem gives us

\[B G=\sqrt{\frac{2 a^{2} c^{2} b}{b\left(a^{2}+c^{2}\right)}-\frac{a^{2} b^{2} c^{2}}{a^{2}+c^{2}}}=\frac{a c}{a^{2}+c^{2}} \sqrt{2\left(a^{2}+c^{2}\right)-b^{2}}=\frac{390 \sqrt{37}}{197}\]

Then by similar triangles,

\[Z W=H Y \frac{Z A}{H A}=B G \frac{Y C}{G C} \frac{Z A}{H A}=B G \frac{1}{2} \frac{6}{7}=\frac{1170 \sqrt{37}}{1379}\]

where \(\frac{Z A}{H A}\) is found with mass points or Ceva.
